description: This file provides utility functions for formatting currency amounts, specifically USD, with dynamic precision and optional credits suffix. It includes functions for formatting amounts with variable decimal places, appending credits, and handling invalid inputs.

methods.name: formatCurrencyAmount
methods.description: Formats a numeric value as a currency string with optional credits suffix, handling dynamic decimal precision based on the value's magnitude.

methods.name: formatUsdWithCreditsText
methods.description: Convenience function to format USD amounts with credits appended, using default options.

methods.name: formatUsdUpToSixDecimals
methods.description: Formats a USD amount with up to six decimal places and thousands separators.
